verdict.rationale: Abacum is a SaaS FP&A platform, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack never mentions a public API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. The evidence on scenario 'versions' and edit history describes model and data versioning, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
